UIExtenderEx
Copyright BUTR, shdwp and contributors
License: GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 or later
Project: https://github.com/BUTR/Bannerlord.UIExtenderEx

This KaiTOR Diplomacy package uses UIExtenderEx as an unmodified, replaceable shared library
to inject the messenger button into Bannerlord's EncyclopediaHeroPage. UIExtenderEx remains
licensed under LGPL-3.0-or-later. The library DLL is kept separate from KaiTOR_Diplomacy.dll
so it can be replaced by an interface-compatible build.
